docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Alistair McLeay

Co-Founder & Co-CEO at Grw AI

I'm most active on [X / Twitter](https://x.com/alistairmcleay) and [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/alistairmcleay) if you want to follow what I'm up to. I also have a [Substack](https://substack.com/@alistairmcleay) for more in-depth, less frequent writing. I'm Co-Founder & Co-CEO at [Grw AI](https://www.grw.ai/) where we're pushing the limits of what's possible with foundation models, building a superhuman sales leader. I have a Masters in Machine Learning & Machine Intelligence from Cambridge University where I [trained LLM agents through self-play](https://www.mlmi.eng.cam.ac.uk/files/2021-2022_dissertations/joint_learning_of_practical_dialogue_systems_and_user_simulators_reduced.pdf). I built [two software companies](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alistairmcleay/) before starting Grw AI, one in NZ and one in the US. I love travelling, surfing, climbing mountains, and anything adrenaline-inducing.

docs.title: What I'm Building
docs.text: I'm Co-Founder & Co-CEO at Grw AI where we're pushing the limits of what's possible with foundation models. We're building a superhuman sales leader—AI that coaches salespeople to be better at their craft.

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
I have a Masters in Machine Learning & Machine Intelligence from Cambridge University where I researched how to train LLM agents through self-play to develop negotiation and persuasion capabilities.

Before Grw AI, I built two software companies—one in New Zealand and one in the US. That experience taught me as much about building products and teams as any degree could.

docs.title: Beyond Work
docs.text:
When I'm not working, you'll find me:

  • Travelling — exploring new places and cultures
  • Surfing — chasing waves whenever I can
  • Climbing mountains — the higher the better
  • Anything adrenaline-inducing — if it gets the heart racing, I'm in

docs.title: Connect
docs.text:
I'm most active on X / Twitter and LinkedIn. I also write occasionally on Substack for longer, more in-depth pieces.

Feel free to reach out—I'm always happy to chat about AI, startups, or any of my hobbies.

docs.title: Hello World
docs.text: Welcome to my new blog. I'm excited to finally have a place to share my thoughts on AI engineering, company building, and the lessons I'm learning along the way.

docs.title: What to Expect
docs.text:
I'll be writing about:

  • AI Engineering: Technical deep-dives into building with LLMs, agent architectures, and the practical challenges of shipping AI products
  • Company Building: Lessons from building Grw AI and my previous ventures
  • Personal: Reflections on life, travel, and the pursuit of interesting experiences
  • Learnings: Books, ideas, and frameworks that have shaped my thinking

docs.title: Why Write?
docs.text:
Writing forces clarity of thought. It's easy to have vague ideas floating around, but putting them into words requires precision. I'm hoping this practice will sharpen my thinking while creating something useful for others.

Stay tuned for more.
